provenance.source: openstudio-necb umbrella pipeline self-declaration — the compliance determination itself (Part 8 Section 8.4). 2025 renumbering: the reference-building subsection is 8.4.5 (2020: 8.4.4); 8.4.4 is the NEW Energy Use Intensity path, which exists only here and only in this gem (tiers.rb).
provenance.note: This file carries ONLY article_coverage — the umbrella has no rule data of its own (verdicts and iteration logic live in compliance.rb; EUI arithmetic in tiers.rb reads eui_targets_2025.json).

articles.title: Determination of Compliance
articles.how: The pipeline computes the (2) annual-energy verdict (against the 8.4.4 EUI target or the 8.4.5 reference building), the (3)/(4) unmet-hours verdicts (with the vacuous-cooling determination when the proposed has no mechanical cooling), and the sentence-(5) capacity auto-iteration (global sizing-factor bumps with hard-sized-equipment stall detection) — compliance.rb; asserted by test_compliance.rb.

articles.title: Treatment of Process Loads
articles.how: (2): on the reference path, process loads in the proposed are automatically in the reference (clone; no transform touches them). On the EUI path the PL term is the caller-supplied process_loads_kwh added to the BET (8.4.4.1.(2)). (1) exclusion-by-default is the modeller's input decision.

articles.title: General
articles.how: Compliance is assessed through modeling: the umbrella is the only gem permitted to run EnergyPlus, and a determination requires sizing + annual runs (simulate: :annual); any other mode is flagged non-determining. The EUI path still requires the annual run of the proposed.

articles.title: Calculation Methods
articles.how: (2)/(3) annual 8760-h runs at hourly timestep; a shortened run_period computes the arithmetic but flags NOT code-compliant. (4) software conformance rests on EnergyPlus's ANSI/ASHRAE 140 testing (see 8.4.2.11).
articles.gaps: (5) redundant/back-up equipment exclusion and (6) exceptional-calculation-method routing are modeller decisions, not automated; (1) end-use accounting covers what the model contains — elevators/escalators (j) are not added by the pipeline.

articles.title: Climatic Data
articles.how: Weather attach (CWEC EPW + DDY design days) via OpenStudioSimulation::Runner.attach_weather!; HDD resolution explicit arg -> Table C-1 -> .stat fallback (openstudio-envelope Climate).
articles.gaps: (2) choice among multiple urban climatic data sets is the modeller's; the pipeline attaches exactly the file it is given.

articles.title: General (Proposed Building)
articles.how: The proposed model is simulated as supplied — the pipeline applies no transforms to it (weather attach only); reference transforms operate on a clone. Guaranteed by test_caller_model_never_mutated (test_compliance.rb).

articles.title: General (Energy Use Intensity path)
articles.how: BET = sum(A_i x EUI_i) + PL from Table 8.4.4.1 (tiers.rb) with archetype floor areas COMPUTED FROM THE MODEL per (3) (Archetypes.resolve!: partofTotalFloorArea non-plenum spaces x multiplier, a documented proxy for "conditioned"); (4) unmapped space functions distributed pro-rata (Archetypes.bet_areas — over-assignment impossible by construction); (1) coverage >= 90% and the Table-note HDD < 9000 bound are HARD refusals on the :eui path (a verdict outside applicability is not a determination); unknown archetype names raise.

articles.title: Operating Schedules, Internal Loads and Service Water Heating Loads (EUI path)
articles.gaps: Unmapped spaces keep their modeled loads (the Table applies "for the applicable building archetype"); spaces with no water-use equipment warn rather than gaining a SWH system.
articles.how: Implemented check-then-normalize (Archetypes.conformance / Archetypes.normalize!): the proposed is checked against the Table 8.4.4.2 values (occupant density, receptacle W/m2, SWH L/h/occupant; occupancy/equipment/setpoint schedule PROFILES compared hourly against the archetype letter) and, when non-conformant, REWRITTEN to them before the EUI-path annual run. On reference-path runs the eui_supplement verdict is only computed from the as-specified run when the check passes; otherwise not-computed with the mismatch list, or a separate normalized annual run with run_normalized: true. Lighting OPERATION schedules follow the archetype letter and outdoor air is set to the ASHRAE 62.1-2016 Table 6.2.2.1 rates at the Table 8.4.4.2 occupant density — both interpretations ADOPTED by project decision 2026-07-22 (controls credit unaffected: it flows through the 4.3.2.10 power multipliers, 8.4.3.4 modeller-side). Round-trip pinned by test (normalize! then conformance must agree).
